provenance.extraction: closed AST literals, set comprehensions and unions only; no server import or execution

action_source_count: SELECT count(*) AS used FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND (%(kind)s::text IS NULL OR kind = %(kind)s) AND source_key LIKE %(prefix)s || '%%'
attempt_reservation: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation_active OR lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AS reserved, bool_or(attempt_id = %(attempt_id)s AND phase = 'stopped') AS attempt_stopped FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s
attempt_result_content: SELECT a.result_sha256, a.result_byte_count, a.phase, a.reservation_active, a.lease_expires_at, string_agg(c.content, '' ORDER BY c.chunk_index) AS content FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts a JOIN forge_agent.coding_result_chunks c ON (c.owner_id, c.project_alias, c.task_id, c.attempt_id) = (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id) WHERE a.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND a.task_id = %(task_id)s AND a.attempt_id = %(attempt_id)s GROUP BY a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id
attempts_leased: SELECT a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.agent_profile FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts a WHERE a.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND a.agent_profile = ANY(%(profiles)s) AND a.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND a.lease_expires_at > %(now)s ORDER BY a.started_at ASC
author_handoff_available: SELECT to_regprocedure('forge_agent.coding_workflow_author_handoff(uuid)') IS NOT NULL AS available
blocked_witnessed: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s AND created_at >= %(since)s AND (event_kind IN ('quota_blocked', 'blocked_auth', 'blocked_permission', 'cancel_requested', 'cancelled') OR payload->>'status' IN ('quota_blocked', 'blocked_auth', 'blocked_permission', 'cancel_requested', 'cancelled'))) AS blocked
candidate_commits_for_tasks: SELECT DISTINCT candidate_commit FROM forge_agent.coding_reviews WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = ANY(%(task_ids)s::uuid[]) AND candidate_commit IS NOT NULL
coding_events_after: SELECT event_id, correlation_id, sequence, event_kind, created_at, payload FROM forge_agent.coding_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s AND sequence > %(sequence)s ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT %(limit)s
deadline_retry_actions: SELECT x.* FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions x WHERE x.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND x.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND x.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND x.kind = 'decide' AND x.status = 'completed' AND x.source_key LIKE 'native-deadline-retry:%%' AND x.intent->>'policy' = %(policy)s AND x.intent->>'task_id' = %(task_id)s AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts p WHERE (p.owner_id, p.project_alias, p.task_id) = (x.owner_id, x.project_alias, %(task_id)s) AND p.phase = 'stopped' AND p.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.reservation_active AND p.lease_expires_at IS NULL AND p.published_at > x.created_at AND p.published_at < %(before)s AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts r WHERE (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id, r.attempt_id) = (p.owner_id, p.project_alias, p.task_id, p.attempt_id))) ORDER BY x.created_at, x.action_id
deadline_retry_count: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND status = 'completed' AND source_key LIKE 'native-deadline-retry:%%'
external_filed_defects: SELECT id AS task_id,title,defect->>'severity' AS severity FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=%(owner_id)s AND project_alias=%(project_alias)s AND task_kind='defect' AND (defect->>'discovering_task_id'=%(task_id)s::text OR (%(workflow_id)s::text IS NOT NULL AND defect->>'discovering_workflow_id'=%(workflow_id)s::text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks member WHERE member.owner_id=coding_tasks.owner_id AND member.project_alias=coding_tasks.project_alias AND member.id=(coding_tasks.defect->>'discovering_task_id')::uuid AND (member.workflow_id=%(workflow_id)s::uuid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_external_workflow.tasks membership WHERE membership.owner_id=member.owner_id AND membership.project_alias=member.project_alias AND membership.task_id=member.id AND membership.workflow_id=%(workflow_id)s::uuid)))) AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND NOT forge_external_workflow_api.is_internal(owner_id,project_alias,id) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 50
filed_defects: SELECT id AS task_id,title,defect->>'severity' AS severity FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=%(owner_id)s AND project_alias=%(project_alias)s AND task_kind='defect' AND (defect->>'discovering_task_id'=%(task_id)s::text OR (%(workflow_id)s::text IS NOT NULL AND defect->>'discovering_workflow_id'=%(workflow_id)s::text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks member WHERE member.owner_id=coding_tasks.owner_id AND member.project_alias=coding_tasks.project_alias AND member.id=(coding_tasks.defect->>'discovering_task_id')::uuid AND member.workflow_id=%(workflow_id)s::uuid)) AND parent_task_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 50
gpu_ready_models: SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM forge_agent.gpu_worker_readiness WHERE model_id = ANY(%(model_ids)s) AND ready AND seen_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '30 seconds'
gpu_worker_ready: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.gpu_worker_readiness WHERE model_id = %(model_id)s AND ready AND seen_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '30 seconds') AS worker_ready
hosted_observations_for_tasks: SELECT h.candidate_commit, h.checks FROM forge_agent.coding_hosted_checks h JOIN forge_agent.coding_publications p ON p.publication_id = h.publication_id WHERE h.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND h.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND p.task_id = ANY(%(task_ids)s::uuid[]) ORDER BY h.observed_at ASC, h.observation_id ASC LIMIT 32
ide_chat_source: SELECT (queued.data->>'source_message_position')::int AS position, queued.data->'source_attachment' AS attachment FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events queued ON queued.run_id = r.id AND queued.sequence = 1 WHERE r.ide_chat_owner_id = %(ide_chat_owner_id)s AND r.ide_chat_id = %(ide_chat_id)s AND r.status = 'completed' AND r.ide_chat_revision <= %(revision)s AND queued.data ? 'source_attachment' ORDER BY r.ide_chat_revision
ide_chats_visible: SELECT id, revision, title, messages, updated_at, expires_on, time_zone, expires_at FROM forge_agent.ide_chats WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND removed_at IS NULL AND title IS NOT NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > clock_timestamp()) AND (%(chat_id)s::uuid IS NULL OR id = %(chat_id)s) AND (%(cursor_updated_at)s::timestamptz IS NULL OR (updated_at, id) < (%(cursor_updated_at)s, %(cursor_id)s)) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT %(limit)s
ide_tabs_beyond_offset: SELECT tab_id FROM forge_agent.ide_workspace_tabs WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s ORDER BY touched_at DESC, tab_id OFFSET %(offset)s
inference_ready_runs: SELECT result.run_id FROM forge_agent.inference_results result JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = result.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.distributed AND r.status = 'result_ready' ORDER BY (r.mail_thread_id IS NOT NULL), result.accepted_at, result.run_id LIMIT %(limit)s
jenkins_events_for_family: SELECT event_kind, job_name, build_number, queue_id, commit_sha, branch, build_result, stage_name, stage_status, occurred_at, sequence, correlation_id, action_id, branch_scope FROM forge_agent.jenkins_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND (correlation_id = ANY(%(correlation_ids)s) OR commit_sha = ANY(%(commit_shas)s) OR (%(main_action)s IS NOT NULL AND action_id = %(main_action)s AND commit_sha = %(main_commit)s AND branch_scope = 'main')) ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT 512
jenkins_next_sequence: SELECT coalesce(max(sequence), 0) + 1 AS next_seq FROM forge_agent.jenkins_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s
linked_family_tasks: SELECT id, correlation_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND (correlation_id = %(correlation_id)s OR workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s OR id = %(root_id)s OR repair_root_task_id = %(root_id)s) LIMIT 64
mail_page: WITH page AS (SELECT sequence, role, content, run_id FROM forge_agent.mail_messages WHERE (owner_id, thread_id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(thread_id)s) AND sequence > %(sequence)s ORDER BY sequence LIMIT %(limit)s) SELECT p.sequence, p.role, p.content, CASE WHEN p.role = 'user' THEN (SELECT r.created_at FROM forge_agent.runs r WHERE (r.mail_owner_id, r.mail_thread_id, r.id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(thread_id)s, p.run_id)) ELSE (SELECT e.recorded_at FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.event_type = 'completed' WHERE (r.mail_owner_id, r.mail_thread_id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(thread_id)s) AND (r.id = p.run_id OR r.mail_source_run_id = p.run_id) ORDER BY e.recorded_at DESC, r.id DESC, e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) END AS created_at, CASE WHEN p.role = 'assistant' THEN (SELECT 'length' FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.event_type = 'completed' WHERE (r.mail_owner_id, r.mail_thread_id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(thread_id)s) AND (r.id = p.run_id OR r.mail_source_run_id = p.run_id) AND e.data->>'finish_reason' = 'length' LIMIT 1) END AS finish_reason FROM page p ORDER BY p.sequence
mail_thread_messages: SELECT m.role, m.content FROM forge_agent.mail_messages m WHERE (m.owner_id, m.thread_id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(thread_id)s) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.mail_messages reply WHERE reply.run_id = m.run_id AND reply.role = 'assistant') ORDER BY m.sequence
max_infrastructure_retries: SELECT coalesce((SELECT (b.policy->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer FROM forge_agent.coding_review_budget b WHERE b.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND b.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND b.root_task_id = %(root_task_id)s), p.max_infrastructure_retries) AS max_infrastructure_retries FROM forge_agent.coding_review_policy p WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s
max_review_no: SELECT max(review_no) AS latest FROM forge_agent.coding_reviews WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s
merge_commit_by_project: SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.project_alias) a.project_alias, a.finish_receipt->'receipt'->>'merge_commit' AS merge_commit FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions a JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) WHERE a.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND a.kind = 'merge' AND a.status = 'completed' AND a.finish_receipt->>'status' = 'merged' AND a.finish_receipt->'receipt'->>'merge_commit' = a.intent->>'merge_commit' AND w.phase = 'completed' ORDER BY a.project_alias, a.updated_at DESC, a.action_id DESC
merge_head: SELECT a.finish_receipt->'receipt'->>'merge_commit' AS head FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions a JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) WHERE a.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND a.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND a.kind = 'merge' AND a.status = 'completed' AND a.finish_receipt->>'status' = 'merged' AND a.finish_receipt->'receipt'->>'merge_commit' = a.intent->>'merge_commit' AND w.phase = 'completed' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.action_id DESC LIMIT 1
message_totals: SELECT count(*) AS count, coalesce(sum(octet_length(content)), 0) AS bytes, coalesce(max(position), 0) AS last_position FROM forge_agent.messages m JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.conversation_id = %(conversation_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s
needs_reconcile_witnessed: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s AND event_kind = 'needs_reconcile' AND payload->>'attempt_id' = %(attempt_id)s AND payload->>'reason' IN ('deadline_exceeded', 'stopped_without_publication') AND created_at >= %(since)s) AS witnessed
publication_required_green: SELECT h.required_green FROM forge_agent.coding_publications p JOIN forge_agent.coding_reviews r ON r.review_id = p.review_id AND r.status = 'approved' JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.required_green FROM forge_agent.coding_hosted_checks x WHERE x.publication_id = p.publication_id AND x.candidate_commit = p.commit_sha ORDER BY x.observed_at DESC, x.observation_id DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true WHERE p.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND p.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND p.task_id = %(task_id)s AND p.attempt_id = %(attempt_id)s AND p.status = 'published' AND p.commit_sha = r.candidate_commit ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
published_with_green: SELECT p.*, q.candidate_commit, q.gate_manifest_sha256 FROM forge_agent.coding_publications p JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) = (p.owner_id, p.project_alias, p.task_id, p.attempt_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reviews q ON q.review_id = p.review_id WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND p.status = 'published' AND q.status = 'approved' AND q.repair_task_id IS NULL AND q.owner_decision->>'closed_by' = 'peer_reviewer' AND (SELECT h.required_green FROM forge_agent.coding_hosted_checks h WHERE h.publication_id = p.publication_id AND h.candidate_commit = p.commit_sha ORDER BY h.observed_at DESC, h.observation_id DESC LIMIT 1) IS TRUE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
recent_completed_transcripts: SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role', m.role, 'content', m.content) ORDER BY m.position) AS messages FROM (SELECT r.id, r.conversation_id, r.created_at FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.sequence = 1 AND e.event_type = 'queued' WHERE c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.status = 'completed' AND e.data @> '{"allow_partial": true}'::jsonb AND r.ide_chat_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 16) recent JOIN forge_agent.messages m ON m.conversation_id = recent.conversation_id AND m.run_id = recent.id GROUP BY recent.id, recent.created_at ORDER BY recent.created_at DESC, recent.id DESC
result_chunks_page: WITH spans AS (SELECT chunk_index, content, byte_length, coalesce(sum(byte_length) OVER (ORDER BY chunk_index ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS start_byte, sum(byte_length) OVER (ORDER BY chunk_index) AS end_byte FROM forge_agent.coding_result_chunks WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s AND attempt_id = %(attempt_id)s) SELECT chunk_index, content, byte_length, start_byte, end_byte FROM spans WHERE end_byte > %(end_byte)s AND start_byte < %(start_byte)s ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
resume_receipt: SELECT r.attempt_id, r.task_revision, r.workspace_digest, c.receipt_json FROM forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts r JOIN forge_agent.coding_control_receipts c ON (c.owner_id, c.project_alias, c.task_id) = (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id) WHERE (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id, r.receipt_id) = (%(owner_id)s, %(project_alias)s, %(task_id)s, %(receipt_id)s) AND c.action = 'resume' AND c.idempotency_key = %(idempotency_key)s AND c.base_revision = r.task_revision AND c.result_revision = r.task_revision + 1
retained_baseline_sources: SELECT intent,finish_receipt,source_key FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE owner_id=%(owner_id)s AND project_alias=%(project_alias)s AND workflow_id=%(workflow_id)s AND kind='decide' AND status='completed' AND source_key LIKE 'baseline-continuation:%%'
retained_incident_sources: SELECT finish_receipt FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE owner_id=%(owner_id)s AND project_alias=%(project_alias)s AND workflow_id=%(workflow_id)s AND kind='decide' AND status='completed' AND source_key LIKE 'policy-continuation:%%'
retry_policy_checkpoint: SELECT payload FROM forge_agent.coding_events WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND task_id = %(task_id)s AND event_kind = 'checkpoint' AND payload->>'stage' = 'retry_policy_updated' AND payload->>'policy' = 'forge-agent-retry-v1' AND payload->>'workflow_id' = %(workflow_id)s AND payload->>'snapshot_digest' = %(snapshot_digest)s ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
review_root_tasks: SELECT r.source_task_id, w.root_task_id FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_reviews r JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) WHERE r.workflow_review_id = %(workflow_review_id)s AND w.owner_id = %(owner_id)s
review_with_max_rounds: SELECT r.*, coalesce((SELECT (b.policy->>'max_rounds')::integer FROM forge_agent.coding_review_budget b JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, coalesce(t.repair_root_task_id, t.id)) = (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) WHERE t.owner_id = r.owner_id AND t.project_alias = r.project_alias AND t.id = r.task_id), p.max_rounds, %(fallback_max_rounds)s) AS max_rounds FROM forge_agent.coding_reviews r LEFT JOIN forge_agent.coding_review_policy p USING (owner_id, project_alias) WHERE r.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND r.task_id = %(task_id)s ORDER BY r.review_no DESC LIMIT 1
revival_decide_count: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND source_key LIKE %(source_key_pattern)s
revival_floor: SELECT max(created_at) AS floor FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND status = 'completed' AND source_key LIKE %(source_key_pattern)s
run_chat_mail: SELECT r.ide_chat_id, r.mail_owner_id, r.mail_thread_id FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.id = %(run_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s
run_detail: SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.conversation_id, r.status, r.model_id AS model, r.ide_chat_id AS chat_id, r.ide_chat_revision AS revision, CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN (SELECT m.content FROM forge_agent.messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = r.conversation_id AND m.run_id = r.id AND m.role = 'assistant' ORDER BY m.position DESC LIMIT 1) END AS answer, CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN (SELECT e.data->>'finish_reason' FROM forge_agent.run_events e WHERE e.run_id = r.id AND e.event_type = 'completed' ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) END AS finish_reason FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id LEFT JOIN forge_agent.ide_chats h ON (h.owner_id, h.id) = (r.ide_chat_owner_id, r.ide_chat_id) WHERE r.id = %(run_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.mail_thread_id IS NULL AND (NOT %(distributed_chat)s OR (r.distributed AND r.ide_chat_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (r.ide_chat_id IS NULL OR (h.removed_at IS NULL AND (h.expires_at IS NULL OR h.expires_at > clock_timestamp())))
run_events_after: SELECT e.sequence, e.event_type AS type, e.data - 'fingerprint' AS data, e.recorded_at FROM forge_agent.run_events e JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = e.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE e.run_id = %(run_id)s AND e.sequence > %(sequence)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s ORDER BY e.sequence LIMIT 100
run_fingerprint_by_conversation: SELECT r.id, r.status, e.data->>'fingerprint' AS fingerprint FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.sequence = 1 JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.conversation_id = %(conversation_id)s AND r.request_id = %(request_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s
run_fingerprint_by_mail: SELECT r.id, e.data->>'fingerprint' AS fingerprint FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.sequence = 1 WHERE (r.mail_owner_id, r.mail_thread_id) = (%(mail_owner_id)s, %(mail_thread_id)s) AND r.request_id = %(request_id)s
run_has_chat_or_mail: SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.conversation_id = %(conversation_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND (r.ide_chat_id IS NOT NULL OR r.mail_thread_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1
run_last_error: SELECT e.data->>'error' AS error FROM forge_agent.run_events e JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = e.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE e.run_id = %(run_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND e.event_type IN ('failed', 'interrupted', 'cancelled') ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
run_mail_source: SELECT r.mail_thread_id, coalesce(r.mail_source_run_id, r.id) AS source_run_id, e.data->'mail_profile' AS profile FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.run_events e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.sequence = 1 WHERE r.id = %(run_id)s AND r.mail_owner_id = %(mail_owner_id)s
run_messages_with_source_prompt: SELECT m.role, CASE WHEN m.position = (queued.data->>'source_message_position')::int THEN queued.data->>'source_prompt' ELSE m.content END AS content FROM forge_agent.messages m JOIN forge_agent.run_events queued ON queued.run_id = m.run_id AND queued.sequence = 1 JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = m.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE m.run_id = %(run_id)s AND c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s ORDER BY m.position
run_queue_totals: SELECT count(*) AS total, coalesce(bool_or(r.conversation_id = %(conversation_id)s), false) AS same_conversation FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.status IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting_for_tool', 'result_ready')
sibling_failure: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND id <> %(task_id)s AND status IN ('failed', 'needs_reconcile', 'quota_blocked', 'blocked_auth', 'blocked_permission', 'cancelled')) AS sibling_failure
stage_log_rows: SELECT stage_index, phase_id, logical_stage_id, label, status, returncode, tests_passed, tests_failed, tests_skipped, test_summary, error_excerpt, log_sha256, log_byte_count, log_chunk_count FROM forge_agent.jenkins_stage_results WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND action_id = %(action_id)s AND (correlation_id = ANY(%(correlation_ids)s::uuid[]) OR (action_id = %(main_action)s AND commit_sha = %(main_commit)s AND branch_scope = 'main' AND pipeline_scope = 'main')) AND (logical_stage_id = %(stage_id)s OR phase_id = %(stage_id)s) ORDER BY stage_index ASC
stage_results_for_correlations: SELECT action_id, stage_index, correlation_id, task_id, job_name, build_number, commit_sha, branch_name, branch_scope, pipeline_scope, logical_stage_id, phase_id, phase_kind, label, status, returncode, duration_ms, tests_passed, tests_failed, tests_skipped, test_summary, error_excerpt, log_sha256, log_byte_count, log_chunk_count, created_at FROM forge_agent.jenkins_stage_results WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND (correlation_id = ANY(%(correlation_ids)s::uuid[]) OR (action_id = %(main_action)s AND commit_sha = %(main_commit)s AND branch_scope = 'main' AND pipeline_scope = 'main')) ORDER BY created_at ASC, action_id ASC, stage_index ASC LIMIT 512
stale_distributed_runs: SELECT r.id FROM forge_agent.runs r JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.distributed AND r.status IN ('queued', 'running') AND (r.run_deadline <= clock_timestamp() OR r.lease_until <= clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY least(r.run_deadline, r.lease_until), r.id LIMIT %(limit)s
sweep_escalated_reviews: SELECT r.workflow_review_id, r.target_sha256, r.source_revision, t.project_alias, a.attempt_id, a.result_sha256 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_reviews r JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.reviewer_task_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_attempts a ON (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) WHERE r.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND r.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND r.target_kind = 'code' AND r.status = 'escalated' AND w.phase = 'escalated' AND NOT w.enabled AND w.escalation_reason = %(escalation_reason)s AND t.status = 'awaiting_review' AND a.phase = 'stopped' AND NOT a.reservation_active AND a.lease_expires_at IS NULL AND a.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions x WHERE x.workflow_id = w.workflow_id AND x.source_key LIKE 'peer-verdict-replay:%%') ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 64
sweep_handoff_reviews: SELECT t.project_alias, t.id, t.revision, q.review_id, r.receipt_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reviews q ON (q.owner_id, q.project_alias, q.task_id, q.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts r ON (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id, r.attempt_id, r.task_revision) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id, t.revision) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND t.workflow_required AND t.parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 'awaiting_review' AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL AND w.phase = 'escalated' AND NOT w.enabled AND q.phase = 'local' AND q.status = 'handoff' AND q.candidate_commit IS NULL AND q.source_revision = t.revision AND q.reason IN ('review_unavailable', 'workspace_busy') AND w.escalation_reason = q.reason AND q.infrastructure_retries IN ((w.snapshot->'repair_policy'->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer, coalesce((SELECT (b.policy->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer FROM forge_agent.coding_review_budget b WHERE (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) = (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.root_task_id)), (w.snapshot->'repair_policy'->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer)) AND q.infrastructure_retries > 0 AND r.created_at > q.updated_at AND r.workspace_digest = q.workspace_digest AND q.finish_token IS NOT NULL AND q.finish_receipt->>'status' = 'handoff' AND q.finish_receipt->'outcome'->'verification'->'checks' = '[]'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions a WHERE a.workflow_id = w.workflow_id AND a.source_key LIKE 'source-readiness-delivery:%%') ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 64
sweep_needs_reconcile: SELECT t.project_alias, t.id, t.revision, r.receipt_id, a.attempt_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w ON (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.workflow_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.workflow_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_attempts a ON (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts r ON (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id, r.attempt_id, r.task_revision) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id, t.revision) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND t.workflow_required AND t.mode = 'implement' AND t.status IN ('needs_reconcile', 'failed') AND w.phase IN ('implement', 'repair', 'escalated') AND (w.enabled OR w.phase = 'escalated') AND (w.phase <> 'escalated' OR w.escalation_reason IN ('Agent stopped: needs_reconcile', 'Agent stopped: failed')) AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL AND t.workflow_review_id IS NULL AND a.result_sha256 IS NULL AND a.phase = 'stopped' AND NOT a.reservation_active AND a.lease_expires_at IS NULL AND a.finished_at >= a.deadline_at AND r.created_at >= a.deadline_at AND a.pinned_recipe->>'policy_digest' = ANY(%(policy_digests)s) AND t.agent_profile = w.snapshot->>'author_profile' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_events e WHERE (e.owner_id, e.project_alias, e.task_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) AND e.event_kind = 'needs_reconcile' AND e.payload->>'attempt_id' = a.attempt_id::text AND e.payload->>'reason' IN ('deadline_exceeded', 'stopped_without_publication') AND e.created_at >= a.deadline_at) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions x WHERE x.workflow_id = w.workflow_id AND x.kind = 'decide' AND (x.source_key = 'native-deadline-retry:' || a.attempt_id::text OR (%(allow_any_retry)s AND x.source_key LIKE 'native-deadline-retry:%%'))) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 64
sweep_needs_reconcile_handoff: SELECT t.project_alias, t.id, t.revision, r.receipt_id, a.attempt_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w ON (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.workflow_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.workflow_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_attempts a ON (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts r ON (r.owner_id, r.project_alias, r.task_id, r.attempt_id, r.task_revision) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id, t.revision) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND t.workflow_required AND t.mode = 'implement' AND t.status IN ('needs_reconcile', 'failed') AND w.phase IN ('implement', 'repair', 'escalated') AND (w.enabled OR w.phase = 'escalated') AND (w.phase <> 'escalated' OR w.escalation_reason IN ('Agent stopped: needs_reconcile', 'Agent stopped: failed')) AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL AND t.workflow_review_id IS NULL AND a.result_sha256 IS NULL AND a.phase = 'stopped' AND NOT a.reservation_active AND a.lease_expires_at IS NULL AND a.finished_at >= a.deadline_at AND r.created_at >= a.deadline_at AND a.pinned_recipe->>'policy_digest' = ANY(%(policy_digests)s) AND t.agent_profile = coalesce(forge_agent.coding_workflow_author_handoff(w.workflow_id)->'intent'->>'target_profile', w.snapshot->>'author_profile') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_events e WHERE (e.owner_id, e.project_alias, e.task_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) AND e.event_kind = 'needs_reconcile' AND e.payload->>'attempt_id' = a.attempt_id::text AND e.payload->>'reason' IN ('deadline_exceeded', 'stopped_without_publication') AND e.created_at >= a.deadline_at) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions x WHERE x.workflow_id = w.workflow_id AND x.kind = 'decide' AND (x.source_key = 'native-deadline-retry:' || a.attempt_id::text OR (%(allow_any_retry)s AND x.source_key LIKE 'native-deadline-retry:%%'))) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 64
sweep_orphan_tasks: SELECT t.project_alias, t.id, t.created_at, t.agent_profile, t.mode, b.policy FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_review_budget b ON (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND t.workflow_id IS NULL AND (t.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks child WHERE (child.owner_id, child.project_alias, child.repair_root_task_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) AND child.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled'))) AND b.policy IS DISTINCT FROM %(policy)s AND (b.policy - ARRAY['max_rounds', 'max_stagnant_rounds', 'max_infrastructure_retries']) = (%(policy)s::jsonb - ARRAY['max_rounds', 'max_stagnant_rounds', 'max_infrastructure_retries']) AND (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz IS NULL OR (t.created_at, t.id) > (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz, %(cursor_id)s::uuid)) ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT 64
sweep_publication_failures: SELECT t.project_alias, t.id, t.revision, q.review_id, q.reconciliation_receipt_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w USING (workflow_id) JOIN forge_agent.coding_reviews q ON (q.owner_id, q.project_alias, q.task_id, q.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND t.workflow_required AND t.parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.mode = 'implement' AND t.status = 'awaiting_review' AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL AND w.phase = 'escalated' AND NOT w.enabled AND w.escalation_reason = 'publication_command_failed' AND q.status = 'handoff' AND q.phase = 'local' AND q.reason = 'publication_command_failed' AND q.candidate_commit IS NULL AND q.verification->'checks_passed' = 'false'::jsonb AND q.verification->'checks' = '[]'::jsonb AND q.verification->'cleanup_confirmed' = 'true'::jsonb AND q.source_revision = t.revision AND q.finish_token IS NOT NULL AND q.finish_receipt->>'status' = 'handoff' AND q.finish_receipt->'outcome'->>'reason' = 'publication_command_failed' AND q.infrastructure_retries < coalesce((SELECT (b.policy->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer FROM forge_agent.coding_review_budget b WHERE (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) = (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.root_task_id)), (w.snapshot->'repair_policy'->>'max_infrastructure_retries')::integer) ORDER BY q.updated_at DESC LIMIT 64
sweep_retry_policy_workflows: SELECT w.* FROM forge_agent.coding_workflows w JOIN forge_agent.coding_review_budget b ON (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) = (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.root_task_id) WHERE w.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND w.project_alias = ANY(%(project_aliases)s) AND w.phase NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND ((w.snapshot->>'max_plan_revisions')::integer < 20 OR (w.snapshot->>'max_code_revisions')::integer < 20 OR b.policy->'max_rounds' <> '20'::jsonb OR b.policy->'max_stagnant_rounds' <> '20'::jsonb OR b.policy->'max_infrastructure_retries' <> '20'::jsonb) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM forge_agent.coding_events e WHERE (e.owner_id, e.project_alias, e.task_id) = (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.root_task_id) AND e.event_kind = 'checkpoint' AND e.payload->>'stage' = 'retry_policy_updated' AND e.payload->>'policy' = 'forge-agent-retry-v1' AND e.payload->>'scope_id' = w.workflow_id::text) AND (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz IS NULL OR (w.created_at, w.workflow_id) > (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz, %(cursor_id)s::uuid)) ORDER BY w.created_at, w.workflow_id LIMIT 64
task_receipt_by_idempotency: SELECT t.intent_digest, e.payload AS receipt_json FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_events e ON (e.owner_id, e.project_alias, e.task_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) AND e.sequence = 1 WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND t.idempotency_key = %(idempotency_key)s
task_root: SELECT coalesce(repair_root_task_id, id) AS root FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND id = %(task_id)s
tasks_page: SELECT t.id, t.correlation_id, t.project_alias, t.base_revision, t.mode, t.agent_profile, t.recipe_digest, t.status, t.revision, t.created_at, t.title, t.workflow_id, t.workflow_required, t.task_kind, t.defect, w.phase AS workflow_phase FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t LEFT JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w ON (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.workflow_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.workflow_id) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND (NOT %(exclude_external)s OR NOT forge_external_workflow_api.is_internal(t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id)) AND (%(task_kind_filter)s::text IS NULL OR t.task_kind = %(task_kind_filter)s::text) AND (%(status_filter)s::text IS NULL OR t.status = %(status_filter)s::text) AND (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz IS NULL OR (t.created_at, t.id) > (%(cursor_created_at)s::timestamptz, %(cursor_id)s::uuid)) ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT %(limit)s
tasks_with_attempts: SELECT t.*, a.phase AS attempt_phase, a.result_sha256, a.reservation_active, a.lease_expires_at, a.published_at, a.summary AS attempt_summary, a.outcome AS attempt_outcome FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t LEFT JOIN forge_agent.coding_attempts a ON (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id, a.attempt_id) = (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id, t.latest_attempt_id) WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s ORDER BY t.created_at
usage_refresh_pending: SELECT DISTINCT ON (profile_alias) profile_alias, refresh_id, status, requested_at FROM forge_agent.coding_usage_refresh_requests WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND profile_alias = ANY(%(profiles)s) AND (status IN ('pending', 'in_progress') OR requested_at >= clock_timestamp() - make_interval(secs => %(secs)s)) ORDER BY profile_alias, requested_at DESC
verification_retries_sum: SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(q.infrastructure_retries - previous.infrastructure_retries, 0)), 0)::integer AS n FROM forge_agent.coding_reviews q JOIN forge_agent.coding_reviews previous ON previous.review_id = q.previous_review_id JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (q.owner_id, q.project_alias, q.task_id) WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND q.review_id <> %(review_id)s
worker_readiness_catalog: SELECT worker_id, policy_digest, projects, profiles, observed_at, (observed_at >= clock_timestamp() - make_interval(secs => %(max_age_seconds)s)) AS is_fresh FROM forge_agent.coding_worker_readiness WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s ORDER BY observed_at DESC, worker_id ASC
worker_readiness_fresh: SELECT policy_digest, projects, profiles FROM forge_agent.coding_worker_readiness WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND policy_digest = ANY(%(policy_digests)s) AND observed_at >= clock_timestamp() - interval '90 seconds'
workflow_action_by_receipt_review: SELECT * FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND finish_receipt->'receipt'->>'review_id' = %(review_id)s AND intent->>'policy' = ANY(%(policies)s)
workflow_actions_by_source_or_policy: SELECT * FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND (source_key = %(source_key)s OR source_key LIKE %(source_pattern)s OR intent->>'policy' = ANY(%(policies)s)) ORDER BY created_at, action_id LIMIT %(limit)s
workflow_actions_by_source_or_policy_exi: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND (source_key LIKE %(source_pattern)s OR intent->>'policy' = %(policy)s)) AS orphaned
workflow_actions_by_source_or_policy_req: SELECT * FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND kind = 'decide' AND (source_key LIKE %(source_pattern)s OR intent->>'policy' = %(policy)s) AND intent->'request'->>'task_id' = %(task_id)s AND intent->'request'->>'idempotency_key' = %(idempotency_key)s LIMIT 2
workflow_busy: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND status = ANY(%(task_statuses)s)) OR (%(include_attempts)s AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts a JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id) WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND (a.reservation_active OR a.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions WHERE workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND status IN ('pending', 'leased')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_publications p JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (p.owner_id, p.project_alias, p.task_id) WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND (%(publication_statuses)s::text[] IS NULL OR p.status = ANY(%(publication_statuses)s))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_reviews q JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (q.owner_id, q.project_alias, q.task_id) WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND q.status IN ('pending', 'checking')) AS busy
workflow_policy_document: SELECT c.document FROM forge_agent.coding_task_identities i JOIN forge_agent.coding_identity_catalog c ON c.identity_id = i.workflow_policy_id WHERE i.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND i.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s ORDER BY i.created_at LIMIT 1
workflow_root_task: SELECT w.root_task_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks t JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows w ON w.workflow_id = t.workflow_id WHERE t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND t.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND t.id = %(task_id)s
workflow_with_budget: SELECT w.*, coalesce(b.repair_rounds, 0) AS code_revisions FROM forge_agent.coding_workflows w LEFT JOIN forge_agent.coding_review_budget b ON (b.owner_id, b.project_alias, b.root_task_id) = (w.owner_id, w.project_alias, w.root_task_id) WHERE w.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND w.project_alias = %(project_alias)s AND w.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s
workflows_open: SELECT * FROM forge_agent.coding_workflows WHERE owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND phase NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'escalated') ORDER BY created_at
writer_active: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forge_agent.coding_attempts a JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks t ON (t.owner_id, t.project_alias, t.id) = (a.owner_id, a.project_alias, a.task_id) WHERE t.workflow_id = %(workflow_id)s AND t.owner_id = %(owner_id)s AND (a.reservation_active OR a.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) AS writer

forge_agent.coding_feedback: JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks ct ON ct.id = t.task_id
forge_agent.coding_hosted_checks: JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks ct ON ct.id = t.task_id
forge_agent.coding_plan_decisions: JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks ct ON ct.id = t.task_id
forge_agent.coding_publications: JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks ct ON ct.id = t.task_id
forge_agent.coding_retry_event_admission: JOIN forge_agent.coding_retry_events cre ON cre.event_id = t.event_id
forge_agent.coding_reviews: JOIN forge_agent.coding_tasks ct ON ct.id = t.task_id
forge_agent.coding_workflow_actions: JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows wf ON wf.workflow_id = t.workflow_id
forge_agent.coding_workflow_reviews: JOIN forge_agent.coding_workflows wf ON wf.workflow_id = t.workflow_id
forge_agent.inference_results: JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = t.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
forge_agent.jenkins_event_deliveries: JOIN forge_agent.jenkins_events je ON je.event_id = t.event_id
forge_agent.messages: JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = t.conversation_id
forge_agent.run_events: JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = t.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
forge_agent.runs: JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = t.conversation_id
forge_agent.tool_calls: JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = t.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
forge_agent.tool_results: JOIN forge_agent.runs r ON r.id = t.run_id JOIN forge_agent.conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
forge_external_agent.artifacts: JOIN forge_external_agent.assignments a ON a.assignment_id = t.assignment_id
forge_external_workflow.actions: JOIN forge_external_workflow.workflows ew ON ew.workflow_id = t.workflow_id
forge_external_workflow.contexts: JOIN forge_external_agent.assignments a ON a.assignment_id = t.assignment_id
forge_external_workflow.reviews: JOIN forge_external_workflow.workflows ew ON ew.workflow_id = t.workflow_id
